evidence_requests: Provide the admissible record text for BPROC-026-B through BPROC-026-E, especially the exact storage-control inconsistency and whether it remained unresolved at decision time.

decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows a material unresolved risk sufficient under policy to support rejection.
Do not treat quality-process gaps or questionnaire inconsistencies alone as proof of reject-level control failure.
Do not rely on unlogged private security-review results or implied undisclosed findings.
If the admissible record supports only follow-up or escalation, not rejection, the action is not fully supported.
